<div class="paper-title">Sources, Review Status, and Record of Changes</div>

## Sources used to create this site

| Source | Exact saved version used | Material used here |
|---|---|---|
| `SPRFMO/jmMSE` isolated 500-draw refinement worktree | `77968e4a9febcad5315a7c00419b6d1690e3e102`; the release check also reports whether tracked changes remain | Primary source: completed 500-posterior reference and nine-OM robustness runs for the eight CMP comparison cases |
| `SPRFMO/scw17` | `0eb97c9c0329f5ec3338e3cf885f6e1f184c4780` | Secondary source: Papers 03, 04, 08, and 09 plus Quarto conventions |
| `output/jm_candidates_500.slick` | SHA-256 `eac4d67ed02884b833397b601f5406e17c08cfe31cb507db2637a88ff41eddf5` | Combined 500-posterior reference and nine-OM robustness results for eight CMPs, including VB/VB[2025], VB/VB[MSY], and pooled 2041--2050 low-catch probability |

The named package is **SC14-MSE-2026-RC1**. Its [automatic agreement
report](release-check.qmd) provides the complete run list, file list, current
repository revisions, and the result of the numerical comparisons.

The current registry derives from `jmMSE`, not the SCW17 test table. **MP43
(HS-20) and MP44 (PR-20) are the focal analytical cases. MP29 (HS+20) and MP32
(PR+20) are sensitivity cases retained to show the effect of the earlier
annual-limit specification.** MP45--MP48 are additional comparison cases.
This analytical designation is not a formal recommendation or adoption
decision. All eight procedures were refined against the same 500 posterior
draws before the current reference and robustness evaluation.

## Information that must accompany each CMP

Every CMP version must link to:

- the method used to calculate its indicator, harvest control rule, and catch allocation;
- all parameter values and annual data requirements;
- the exact saved version of `jmMSE` used for evaluation;
- OM and robustness scenario definitions;
- definitions of the performance measures and links to the saved results;
- review findings and known limitations; and
- the decision that changed its status.

## Types of change

| Class | Examples | Required review |
|---|---|---|
| Wording only | Spelling, navigation, or clearer background explanation | Documentation review |
| Same calculation, revised code | Software change shown to give the same answers | Code review plus a repeat-calculation test |
| Scientific | Parameter, index, window, HCR, constraint, allocation, or fallback change | Renewed scientific review and normally MSE evaluation |
| Status | Test to shortlist, recommendation, adoption, or retirement | Cited decision record |

## Current status and remaining work

| Item | Status | Evidence or remaining action |
|---|---|---|
| Assign analytical roles and stable identifiers | **Complete for the current analysis** | MP43/MP44 are focal cases; MP29/MP32 are sensitivity cases. Legacy MP identifiers remain the stable links to code and saved results. Formal recommendation or adoption remains a separate decision. |
| Complete common 500-draw tuning and robustness evaluation | **Complete** | All eight CMPs were refined against the same 500 draws and evaluated under the reference OM and nine robustness OMs. |
| Check performance at small trigger changes around each final value | **Complete** | Every CMP was evaluated one grid step below and above its selected trigger using the same saved 500 draws: 0.0625 for hockey-stick rules and 0.03125 for power-ramp rules. All eight local profiles were monotonic; see the [saved summary](../data/candidates/trigger_tolerance_summary_500.csv). In plain language, this checks how much the result changes after a small move on either side of the chosen trigger. |
| Record full run objects with the Slick file and fingerprints | **In progress** | The named release now has a run index, a file list, and an automatic comparison report. Publication remains incomplete until the reporting revision is committed and the tracked changes in the analysis worktree are resolved. |
| Finalize operational specifications | **Partial** | Candidate controls and tested data windows are documented. Authoritative units, annual cutoffs, missing-data rules, rounding, and the formal exceptional-circumstances provisions still require approval and completion. |
| Save worked examples and automatic repeat-calculation checks | **Partial** | A saved retrospective worked example and reproducible report/Slick build scripts exist. Independent automatic repeat-calculation tests against saved expected advice values remain to be added. |
